subject: Television & Streaming
title: Michael Schur and Optimistic Comedy
description: One-minute skill: Michael Schur and Optimistic Comedy.

hook.text: Michael Schur created Parks and Recreation, Brooklyn Nine-Nine, and The Good Place. All three are fundamentally kind.

buildup.text: In an era of cynical antiheroes, Schur bet that audiences would embrace characters who genuinely try to be good people.

discovery.text: The Good Place used moral philosophy as its engine. A sitcom taught Kant and utilitarianism to millions of viewers.

twist.text: Critics assumed nice comedies couldn't be sharp. Schur proved that kindness and intelligence aren't mutually exclusive.

climax.text: Schur's shows endure because optimism ages better than cynicism. People rewatch them when the world feels bleak.

punchline.text: The most radical comedy choice was being genuinely nice.

quiz.question: What academic subject did The Good Place incorporate into its comedy?
